title: Professor Zhao Yang Dong inducted as a Fellow of the Hong Kong Academy of Engineering
content: Professor Zhao Yang Dong, Director of the JC STEM Lab of Future Energy Systems at City University of Hong Kong, signed the Hong Kong Academy of Engineering’s Roll of Fellows on 18 November 2026. He has received his Fellowship certificate from the Academy. Professor Dong’s research focuses on power system planning and stability, smart grids and renewable energy systems. The Lab warmly congratulates him on this honour.

title: CRRC Qingdao leaders visit the lab
content: On November 4, leaders from CRRC Qingdao visited the JC STEM Lab of Future Energy Systems. During the tour, lab members showed the visitors the energy router control cabinet.

title: Prof. Dong speaks on AI and energy systems at EPEE 2026
content: At the 6th International Conference on Energy, Power and Electrical Engineering in Taiyuan, Prof. Zhao Yang Dong delivered a keynote titled “AI + Energy System”. He discussed the role of artificial intelligence in future power systems.

title: Prof. Dong discusses foundation models and AI agents at the Energy Conversion and Economics forum
content: At the 6th Annual Forum on Energy Conversion and Economics in Shanghai, Prof. Zhao Yang Dong gave a keynote on foundation models and AI agents for future power systems. He discussed three tasks: forecasting how the grid will behave, estimating its current operating state, and supporting operational decisions.

title: Prof. Zhao Yang Dong to speak at Hong Kong Future Grid Summit 2026
content: Prof. Zhao Yang Dong has been invited as a guest speaker at the upcoming Hong Kong Future Grid Summit 2026, powered by OSA Group. The summit will take place on March 30 at the Charles K. Kao Auditorium, Hong Kong Science Park. Discussions will cover renewable generators, energy demand research, and operability challenges with data centre load.
